note: Per-cut animated GIF/webp for projector stills. Keyed by medium_image_id + cut label. The stage plays anim when the file is present and falls back to the still (plus ambient in-cut motion) when it is missing or fails to load. dwell_k is the on-screen life multiplier vs a plain still (2x). Pilot stills and prompts: /workspace/animcuts/pilot. Converter: /workspace/animcuts/to_cut_gif.py.
